data_policy.identity: hard association selected once at the anchor from TRAIN and frozen

posterior.profiled_nuisance: per-track TRAIN mean CFO at every rate
posterior.tail_rule: 64-point Gauss-Legendre rational transform on each infinite tail

phase_state_cache.numeric_identity: raw IEEE-754 rate/phase-node bits and exact per-row correction_ns are recorded
phase_state_cache.initial_phase_extent: plus/minus 16 sigma times causal TLE age, including endpoints and zero
phase_state_cache.interpolation: local four-knot barycentric cubic with no extrapolation
phase_state_cache.refinement: deterministic adjacent-interval bisection to at least 0.125 s while midpoint Doppler error exceeds 0.2 Hz
phase_state_cache.direct_overrides: zero, every refined mode, and union of every cell fine-16-sigma node with normalized discrete posterior mass >=1e-6
phase_state_cache.validation: all direct-override nodes, every adjacent interval midpoint, and deterministic hash-selected 1% of nonmaterial fine-16-sigma nodes

smoke_gates.exact_sgp4_nodes: zero, every refined mode, and every fine-16-sigma quadrature node with normalized discrete posterior mass >=1e-6
